svg.title: K14: a ServiceAccount with no Role is authenticated but not authorised
svg.desc: The bot Pod runs as the ServiceAccount leaderboard-bot and calls the API server to list Pods. The API server knows who it is, but no RoleBinding or Role grants it anything, so the answer is 403 Forbidden. The fix adds a Role that allows get and list on pods and a RoleBinding that gives it to the ServiceAccount.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The bot has an ID card, but the door stays shut

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ServiceAccount → RoleBinding → Role: all three links must exist

svg.text: Authentication = the ID card is real. Authorisation = the card is on a list that allows this action.

svg.text: The bot keeps logging "forbidden". kubectl auth can-i list pods, asked as the bot, answers: no.

svg.text: Create the Role (pods: get, list) and a RoleBinding to the ServiceAccount: least privilege, nothing more.
